title: Replace the tautological AuthRepository mock-shape test in epic_25_schema_core_test.dart with real coverage or delete it
why: The test stubs every AuthRepository member on a mocktail Mock and then asserts the mock returns exactly what it was just told to return — it can never fail regardless of what AuthRepositoryImpl actually does, so it gives false confidence that Story 25.11's 'sole firebase_auth consumer' AC is under test. Real behavioural coverage already exists separately in test/features/auth/data/repositories/auth_repository_impl_test.dart, so today this test adds zero net verification while reading like acceptance coverage for the story.
recommendation: Delete the runtime expect() calls and keep this as a documented compile-only shape check (a referenced-but-uncalled function is enough to prove the interface compiles), or point the docstring at auth_repository_impl_test.dart so reviewers don't mistake mock-echo assertions for behavioural coverage.
acceptance_criteria: test either exercises AuthRepositoryImpl directly or is reduced to a compile-time shape check with no expect() calls that only echo their own stubs
